revision: P2 placement (2026-11-21, user: power header to the side in the middle, everything moved down, two M3x10 standoffs above the MCU board). 6HP, two boards: carrier (jack/pot board, 4 layers) and the unchanged MCU board (4 layers) stacked on the carrier F side on 2.54 mm pin headers. THT, standoffs and the fixed back-side parts placed here; the other SMD parts are placed by hand, group by group. R4 (2026-11-22): every SMD part placed and the carrier routed by hand; the routed board owns placement.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY for the carrier and the panel; the MCU board file is unchanged since R2, so it uses mcu_kicad_origin_mm (8 mm less in Y: the board sits 8 mm lower on the panel since P2). The carrier F side faces the panel; the MCU board sits on the carrier F side with its own F side facing the panel, so both KiCad top views equal the front view (no mirroring).

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm carrier as modules/32bit. Held by the four jack nuts and the two M3x10 standoffs MS1/MS2; the MCU board hangs on it.

mcu_pcb.note: 29.0 x 29.55 mm (R1: 2.55 mm longer than S1 so U101 fits below U102 and the USB-C). 4 layers for the USB 2.0 HS pair (90 ohm differential over In1 GND). All SMD on F (one assembly side), facing the panel. P2: the same board (files and JLCPCB set unchanged) sits 8.0 mm lower on the panel, below the two standoffs.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear (as modules/8bit/32bit).
stack_Z_mm.usbc_note: USB-C needs its mouth no more than ~0.3 mm behind the panel front or the plug cannot seat (receptacle depth 6.20 mm vs plug shell 6.51-6.65 mm). HRO TYPE-C-31-D-15 (8.8 mm) on a 1.6 mm MCU board on 2.5 mm header plastic puts it 1.3 mm proud; the same land takes D-15A..D (9.3/10/10.5/12.4 mm). A 1.0 mm MCU board would make it 0.7 mm proud.

layout_note: User brief 2026-10-23: inputs = socket then pot (left to right), outputs = pot then socket. Columns X8.0 / X22.0. P2 (user 2026-11-21): rows IN1 Y54.0, IN2 Y69.0, OUT1 Y94.5, OUT2 Y109.5 (15 mm inside a pair, 25.5 mm between the pairs); the gap between the pairs takes the power header J1 upright at the left edge on B (it needs 25.25 mm between the IN2 jack and the OUT1 pot body). The MCU board takes Y18-47.55 with the USB-C at X15 Y24; MS1/MS2 stand above it at Y13.75. The lowest row is as low as the 1 mm edge keep-out lets the RV4 courtyard go (1.03 mm).

usb_slot.note: Obround NPTH slot for the receptacle shell (8.94 x 3.16 mm, centre X15 Y24): 0.27 mm above and ~1.77 mm below the shell, as on the built modules/usb-audio-max and modules/multi-mix panels (slot extended 1.5 mm downwards); the shell passes through and stands 1.3 mm proud. 2026-11-23 (fab review of modules/32bit, same slot): 9.5 -> 11.0 mm wide, same centre, top and bottom edge. At 9.5 the slot's R2.6 ends cut 0.034 mm into the shell's rounded upper corners (R1.58, nominal); at 11.0 the end circles sit over the shell's end circles, 0.27 mm clear round the upper half.

back_side_parts.band: Eurorack power, upright at the left edge between the IN2 jack and the OUT1 pot. THT, B side; pin 1 / 2 (-12 V) at the bottom
SWD (WCH-LinkE), B side, top centre between the standoffs: +3V3 SWDIO SWCLK GND

power_header.orientation: Upright at the left edge, pin 1 / 2 (-12 V) at the bottom row, +12 V at the top.
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the IN2 jack tails (TN, S at X8), 2.5 mm above B. SMD under it must stay below 2.5 mm. F side: the header tails sit between the IN2 jack S pad (0.52 mm) and the OUT1 pot body (0.5 mm). R4 check: only D1 / D2 (SOD-123, <= 1.35 mm) and the pin row of U2 (SOT-223, <= 1.8 mm) reach into the envelope (X7.8..8.47).

mount_standoffs.hardware: per standoff: 1 x M3 F-F hex standoff 10 mm (user stock), 2 x M3x6 pan/button head (ISO 7380), as modules/4mix. Not M3x8.
mount_standoffs.note: User 2026-11-21: two M3 10 mm hex standoffs above the MCU board, as modules/multi-mix and modules/usb-audio-max, so USB plug forces go into the panel and not into the J6/J7 solder joints (the printed brace of the first board is retired). Carrier F to panel rear is 10 mm (stack_Z_mm), so each standoff is coaxial: carrier hole = panel hole. Y13.75 is as high as the 1 mm edge keep-out allows (B keep-out R3.4 = M3 head R2.85 + margin, as modules/usb-audio-max); the hex corners (R3.18) end at Y16.93, 1.07 mm above the MCU board edge (Y18.0). X5.5 / X24.5 leave the top centre free for the SWD header.
